consequence.statement: The metric is now exposed as lbipam_ips_available instead of lbipam_ips_available_total, so queries, dashboards or alerts that use the old name need updating.
consequence.remediation: Change monitoring queries, dashboards and alerts from lbipam_ips_available_total to lbipam_ips_available.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric lbipam_ips_available_total is renamed to lbipam_ips_available, so anything that queries the old metric name needs updating.

decision.reason: [ev-875bb56564b0] states only that lbipam_ips_available_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_available; the surrounding Changed Metrics section [ev-2e2ab2d37845] gives no further statement that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. Without such a statement an action-eligible kind would over-claim mandatory work, so behavior-change (review, low severity) with a remediation to update queries, dashboards and alerts to the new name is the supported reading.
